decisions.decision: Board agreed to include a list of chairpersons from the board's inception in the new member orientation packet.
decisions.quote: the board agreed to include a list of chairpersons on the board from its inception.

decisions.decision: Board agreed to commemorate all Council on Aging members by listing their names on a plaque.
decisions.quote: the board also agreed to commemorate all members of the council on aging by listing their names on a plaque.

decisions.decision: Ms. Lincoln volunteered to contact the Select Board about staggering board member terms.
decisions.quote: ms. lincoln volunteered to get in touch with the select board to discuss staggering the terms as five out of eleven members' terms are up in june.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: Director requested an increase to the COA budget for FY23 after the Finance Committee budget review.
budget_items.quote: ms. doherty is requesting an $11,344.01 increase in the coa budget for fy23.

budget_items.topic: Allocation of the FY23 budget increase
budget_items.what_was_recorded: The increase would add to the office supply line and fund the Meal Site Manager and Assistant Meal Site Manager positions; the Assistant position is to be funded by Formula Grant funds and the municipal budget.
budget_items.quote: the increase would put another $2,000 in the office supply line, $1,358 will go toward the new meal site manager position, and $7,985 will go toward the assistant meal site manager position.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: The FY23 Formula Grant is expected to be a set amount based on a per capita figure, after the U.S. Census numbers did not come back as anticipated.
budget_items.quote: the fy23 formula grant should come out to $33,000, based on the $12 per capita figure.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: Director applied for an AARP grant to fund the FY23 capital patio project, which was pushed to FY24.
budget_items.quote: ms. doherty has applied for a $50,000 grant from aarp to fund the project.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: A donation was made to the COA Gift Fund.
budget_items.quote: the lunenburg friendly seniors donated $1,000 to the council on aging gift fund.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: Director suggested using Gift Fund money to buy the member plaque; no amount was printed.
budget_items.quote: ms. doherty suggested using money in the council on aging gift fund to purchase the plaque.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: Director highlighted outside grant funding received in FY22 and prospective grants for FY23; no amounts were printed.
budget_items.quote: ms. doherty highlighted outside funding from various grants in fy22, along with prospective grants for fy23.
